blocks.orig: Rhotia Valley Lodge lies on a hill between the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Lake Manyara National Park, offering views of nearby plantations and the Ngorongoro Forest. The lodge offers 15 tented rooms, each with a private terrace and fitted with a king-sized bed, mosquito nets and an ensuite bathroom with hot water for post-safari refreshers. In the main area, you’ll find a refreshing pool, a dining area with a terrace (great for sunsdowners) and WiFi to share your pics of the day. And the best thing? This lodge carries a light footprint, by using indigenous hardwood for its buildings and growing its own vegetables on the farm. It also supports a children’s home (which you are welcome to visit), bakes bread for the school, and has a coffee corner that employs people from the local community.
blocks.html: On a hill between Lake Manyara National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Rhotia Valley Lodge looks out over the Ngorongoro Forest and the plantations nearby. The lodge has 15 tented rooms. Every one has its own terrace, a king-sized bed with mosquito nets and an ensuite bathroom where hot water awaits after a day on safari. Around the main area you will find a pool to cool off in, a place to eat with a terrace (lovely at sundowner time) and WiFi for sharing the day’s photos. Even better, the lodge treads lightly: its buildings are made of indigenous hardwood and the farm supplies its own vegetables. It supports a children’s home too (feel free to visit), bakes bread for the school and has a coffee corner where people from the local community work.
